title: DecoMessages
body:
![title1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0522e03e1ed0ba9e8bdfff2dc9d97d47811b1cc9.png)
_Requires [ConfigAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/configapi)._

This plugin consists of a system based on a configuration file that allows you to decorate/modify various game messages.

**PlaceholderAPI Support!**

You can customize some values ​​in the **decomessages.json** file.

Among the messages you can decorate are:
- **Join Message:** When a player join the server.
- **Quit Message:** When a player quit the server.
- **Chat Message:** When a player chats on the server (the prefix, i.e., what comes before the message).

You can also set a permission that is required to use the chat. There is support for **color codes** in "&" and **hexadecimal** with "&" at the beginning, for example _"&#55FFFF"_.

![title2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8deb73773175a6250310f188f35fb7cc8fdb5e0e.png)

```
{
  "enabled": true,
  "join": "&7[&a+&7] %player%",
  "quit": "&7[&c-&7] %player%",
  "chat": "%player%: &7",
  "perm": "",
  "consoleLogs": false
}
```

![title3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ddcfba54f18a2c4dd4c27290da5c025173ce942f.png)
